why: The default owner palette is what a player who never opens Settings is given once the setting child of #586 lands, so moving it off Classic would recolour every existing player's rings and team colours. Since issue #1057 it is read: an unflagged session resolves its palette from it (loop.ts), and every reader handed no palette falls back to OWNER_PALETTES[DEFAULT_OWNER_PALETTE], so the mutation recolours every multiplayer session. This entry stays scoped to the catalogue test, which names the default directly.
killedBy: owner palettes: the catalogue (issue #1056) offers Classic and High contrast, Classic first and the default, each labelled and complete
